notes: Paper revisits dark photon constraints from CMB spectral distortions using COBE/FIRAS data. Key finding: previous work (McDermott & Witte 2020) neglected entropy extraction, leading to opposite sign and ~1.5× underestimation of constraints. This work includes both energy and entropy changes in photon-to-dark-photon conversion. Data points extracted from Fig. 8 (COBE/FIRAS 95% c.l. limits, solid CosmoTherm curve). The constraint is tightest at md ~ 10^-7 eV (ε ~ 10^-8) and extends to md ~ 10^-3 eV. Large distortion regime (md > 10^-4 eV) treated carefully using CosmoTherm numerical code. Analytic approximation Eq. (11) agrees with full computation to ~10% for COBE/FIRAS. Paper also provides PIXIE forecasts (dashed line in Fig. 8) but COBE/FIRAS is the actual measured limit. Conversion redshift zcon is mass-dependent (Fig. 1) and ranges from dark ages (md < 5×10^-10 eV) through µ/y-distortion eras to post-BBN (md > 5×10^-5 eV). Distortion shape is remarkably close to µ-type independent of conversion redshift in small distortion limit. | selector: text (sole candidate)
